comment: One entry per tool. mode: 'confirm' = the SERVER itself blocks the call until the user approves (MCP elicitation if the client supports it, otherwise a native OS dialog this process spawns directly - no client can bypass this); 'auto' = pre-approved; anything else (e.g. 'deny') = the server refuses to run the tool at all. A tool with no entry here is also refused. Start everything on 'confirm'; loosen individually once proven reliable.

get_chuck_bird_status.notes: Read-only SSH to the bot's prod box: systemctl is-active + journalctl grep. No writes.

list_recent_project_files.notes: Lists file names/mtimes under a path inside the user's home dir. Does not read file contents.

restart_chuck_bird.notes: WRITE action. Runs exactly 'sudo systemctl restart chuckbird' over SSH on 152.67.159.196 - no other commands, no other access. Briefly interrupts the live production bot for connected players.

git_diff.notes: Stages all changes (non-destructive) and returns the diff, scoped to the sychboard/chuck-bird repos only. No free-text path input.

git_commit.notes: WRITE action. Commits staged changes in sychboard or chuck-bird only. Enforced via a custom native dialog (commit-dialog.ps1) showing the real diff and an editable AI-drafted message - not a generic prompt. Never --amend, never rewrites history.

git_push.notes: WRITE action. Pushes the current branch of sychboard or chuck-bird to origin only. Never --force/--force-with-lease, never deletes branches, never rewrites history. Refuses to push main/master unless the caller explicitly names that branch. Should only ever be called when Daniel explicitly asks for a push in that specific message - never auto-offered after a commit (this part is prompt-level guidance in the tool description, not something the server can mechanically verify).
